label: Aristotle, Physics I.8, 191b13-17: Nothing… supports To be in POTENCY_1 to r is to be capable of…
note: Physics I.8, 191b13-17 lets generation come incidentally from privation, non-being in its own respect, in a subject. It bears on the premise by pairing subject and privation as the starting point of change; that being in potency to r is exactly being capable of r and deprived of it is the analyst's identification, not stated in the passage.
